evals.prompt: we have a soc2 audit in two months, help us prepare
evals.expected_output: Maps SOC 2 controls to concrete checkable assertions against live infrastructure (not policy statements), encodes them as versioned checks (OPA/Rego, InSpec, etc.) that run on a schedule independent of the audit date, and pipes results into an immutable, timestamped evidence store so evidence is a query rather than a scavenger hunt.

evals.prompt: a bucket was compliant at launch but the auditor just flagged it as public
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses this as undetected drift from baseline since checks weren't running continuously, and fixes it by adding continuous drift detection/alerting so a manual change violating the control triggers an alert the same day, not at the next audit cycle.

evals.prompt: let's just screenshot the console settings before the audit like last time
evals.expected_output: Pushes back: manual screenshots only prove compliance at one instant and say nothing about the other 364 days when drift actually happens; recommends encoding the control as an automated, continuously running check with evidence generated as a byproduct of normal operation instead.
